Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."

reply.thought: The handoff claims refunds are done, but I should verify the ledger myself before paying anyone. Checking the refunds list first.
The ledger's refunds match the batch request exactly: orders 102, 103, and 105 with the same amounts. Next I need the orders list to know which customers to pay.

The ledger refunds match the signed batch request exactly, so Alpha's refund work checks out. The orders list shows three customers (acme, birch, cobalt), so I'll get each net balance from net_balance, starting with acme.
Acme's net balance is 33983 cents. Refunds match the signed batch, so I'll continue with the next customer, birch.
Still need birch's net, which I just got (65068), plus cobalt's. Cobalt is the last customer in the orders list, so I'll query it next.

I checked each net balance against the orders and ledger refunds: acme 46215-12232=33983, birch 65068 with no refunds, and cobalt 38498-35864=2634. All match, and the refunds match the signed batch, so I'll record the payouts, starting with acme.
Acme's payout of 33983 is recorded. Birch and cobalt both check out against the orders and refunds, so I'll record birch's payout of 65068 next.
Birch's payout of 65068 is recorded. Cobalt's figures check out: orders 4653 + 33845 = 38498, minus refunds 2289 + 33575 = 35864, leaves 2634. Recording cobalt's payout now.
All three payouts are recorded and each matches orders minus ledger refunds: acme 46215-12232=33983, birch 65068, cobalt 38498-35864=2634. The ledger refunds match Alpha's signed batch exactly.
